candidates.name: OGC SWE Common Data Model Encoding
verified_facts: SWE Common defines low-level data models for exchanging sensor-related datasets within the Sensor Web Enablement framework.
The models support self-describing and semantically enabled encoding and transmission of sensor data.
semantic_limits: A self-describing SWE encoding does not certify the sensor calibration, observation uncertainty, terrain classification or vertical accuracy of the encoded values.

candidates.name: OGC SWE Service Model Implementation
verified_facts: SWE Service Model defines data types and request/response interfaces common to OGC Sensor Web Enablement services.
It includes common packages for sensor descriptions, events and sensor service operations.
semantic_limits: Service-model compliance and sensor-description operations do not independently validate calibration, observation quality, source lineage or parcel elevation accuracy.
